messages:
mira: Heads-up — seeing east‑west latency spikes across GPU nodes during the noon batching window (~12:05–12:15). p95 jumps from ~120ms to ~900ms for some flows. Affected racks: r7, r8. https://grafana.redwood/board/nn
ashley: Noted. Any packet-loss counters or RDMA retransmits showing up?
nic-monitor-bot: tor-7/eth1 qdisc drops increased +1200 over 8m, mlx5_0 tx_errors rising. Summary: https://monitoring/redwood/alert/8421 :eyes:
ryan: Captured logs from gpu-72: RDMA retransmits climb and we see TCP fast retransmits too. snippet:
```
[2026-03-18T12:07:02Z] ibp: retransmits=452, rnr_naks=3
[2026-03-18T12:07:05Z] tcp: retransmission from 10.0.7.12 -> 10.0.8.21
```
lee: We pushed an ECMP hashing param across TORs last night (hash-policy tweak). Could be changing flow pinning and exposing MTU/fragmentation differences.
jamal: I repro'd locally with a synthetic peak-batch generator. Doubling batch size triggers same p95 jump and RDMA retransmits spike. Suspect interplay between batching bursts + qdisc coalescing + MTU mismatch.
mira: Quick check — MTU on r7 is 9000 but r8 is 8972. `ip link show` on a node in r8:
```
3: eth0: mtu 8972 qdisc fq_codel state UP group default qlen 1000
```
ashley: Ok that's probably the smoking gun. Plan: short-term mitigations — 1) cap batch sizes for affected fleets, 2) throttle burst ramp in the serving runtime (canary), 3) route noisy tenants away from r8 if capacity allows.
ryan: Also recommend toggling off offloads on suspect NICs as a quick workaround: `ethtool -K eth1 gro off gso off tx offload off` — we've seen GRO+MTU mismatch cause reassembly delays.
infra-bot: Action items:
- mira -> coordinate MTU alignment & TOR config rollback (ETA 2h)
- jamal -> start batch-cap canary on r9 and monitor p95 (in progress)
- ryan -> apply NIC offload toggle to 3 test nodes and report
- lee -> file net-ops ticket for TOR firmware/ECMP interaction
jamal: Canary started on r9 with batch cap 8 (was 16). 25m in and p95 stable ~25ms, no RDMA retransmits so far.
lee: I'll ping @net-ops and include MTU diff + config diff from last night. Also request TOR fw version check.
ashley: Thanks team. Keep this thread updated with canary results and whether any customer retries/billing anomalies crop up. We'll schedule a postmortem if root cause confirmed.
